senses: 2) a Judaite, son of Caleb by his wife Azubah and grandson of Hezron
1) general of king Hadarezer of the Syrians of Zoba in the time of David

H7732.def: Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
senses: 1) the 2nd son of Seir the Horite (Edom) and one of the dukes of the Horites
2) son of Caleb, grandson of Hur, and founder of Kirjath-jearim
3) a Judaite, son of Hur and a descendant of Caleb
1) one of the heads of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
H7733.deriv: active participle from a primitive root meaning to leave (compare {H7662}); forsaking;

senses: 1) to move, go, turn back, turn away

H7736.def: properly, to swell up, i.e. figuratively (by implication of insolence) to devastate

H7737.def: properly, to level, i.e. equalize; figuratively, to resemble; by implication, to adjust (i.e. counterbalance, be suitable, compose, place, yield, etc.)
senses: 1) to agree with, be or become like, level, resemble
H7737.kjv: avail, behave, bring forth, compare, countervail, (be, make) equal, lay, be (make, a-) like, make plain, profit, reckon.

senses: 1) the valley where the king of Sodom met Abram after a battle

H7741.def: Shaveh-Kirjathajim, a place East of the Jordan
senses: Shaveh Kiriathaim = "plain of the double or two city"

senses: 1) (Qal) to meditate, muse, commune, speak, complain
1) to sink down, be bowed down, be humble
1) son of Abraham by his wife Keturah

H7747.def: a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach
senses: 1) an ethnic appellative applied only to Bildad, the friend of Job
1) son of Dan and progenitor of the family of Shuhamites
1) descendants of Shuham, the son of Dan
